description:
Jaehyuk’s life takes an eerie turn when he suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts. Determined to confront Hwanyoung, the man involved with his ex-lover, he’s instead greeted by a disturbing sight—ghosts surrounding Hwanyoung. Convinced the man might be a killer, Jaehyuk starts tailing him. When caught in the act, he impulsively claims to have feelings for Hwanyoung, leading to an unexpected night together. As rumors swirl and Jaehyuk’s initial suspicions begin to waver, he finds himself falling for Hwanyoung—until a tragic and terrifying event changes everything.
